craft_notes: Sthāyin: tuṭi measure. Rows: measure then rhythm. Read aloud: tick-tock.

lines: Two fingers and a quarter, a wink; four winks a watch;
half-winks either end the gloaming — out-breath day, in-breath night.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sapādam aṅguladvayaṃ tuṭiḥ ucyate tāsu catasṛṣu praharaḥ tuṭyardhaṃ tuṭyardhaṃ tatra saṃdhyā evaṃ nirgame dinaṃ praveśe rātriḥ iti tithyudayaḥ
